g.text: paired 80-trial test · BH-FDR classes · Fisher/Holm enrichment

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: Each waveform bar is normalized independently to 100%; brackets test whether fast/narrow neurons are more likely to be cue-excited.

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: One-sided Fisher exact tests compare cue-excited versus all other neurons; Holm correction covers the four displayed scopes. *** P<0.001, ** P<0.01, * P<0.05, ns P≥0.05. Neurons are not animals and waveform class is not a validated cell type.
